cells.gaps: A July 2024 statement that Kenya had no hyperscale cloud (KEN-072) predates the Oracle region reported in September 2026.
cells.note: Two Tier III data centres for hire (KEN-011, KEN-033) and Oracle's public cloud region at iXAfrica's Nairobi campus (KEN-028). The newer report stands over the 2024 statement that no hyperscale cloud had arrived.
